trainers.instruction: Listen to Ana’s presentation on the five senses.

atoms.sound: I use my five senses every day. For example, I use my sense of smell when I walk through the park and smell the spring flowers. I use my sense of touch when I pick out which new pair of socks I want. Tonight, I will use my sense of hearing when I go to the concert with my dad.

instruction.text: Help Mohammed write about the human body.

atoms.b: The human ((body)) has many different parts that have many different jobs. For example, the ((eyes)) help us see the things around us and our ears help us to ((hear)) the outside world. Our ((legs)) allow us to run and our ((hands)) help us hold things. It’s important to take care of our bodies by exercising and eating ((healthy)) food, so that each part can work to its best ability.
